name: @avatark/participation-runtime
description: Executes Sprint 19's visitor-participation domain: pure re-resolved authorization (never trusts a stale snapshot), content-derived participation identity (idempotent by construction), and a reference in-memory repository. Host-neutral, database-neutral, franchise-neutral -- never derives or applies a world consequence itself, that boundary stays entirely Sprint 14/15/18's (lib/participation/hostService.ts only READS their outputs, never re-derives them).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist --declaration --noEmit false --rewriteRelativeImportExtensions --module esnext --moduleResolution bundler && node ../../scripts/fix-dts-extensions.mjs dist
